title: Money
description: Class 3 Money: Indian rupees and paise, adding and subtracting money, making change, and money word problems — with worked examples and free tests.

topics.title: Rupees, Paise, Coins & Notes
topics.concept:
In India we use rupees (₹) and paise. 100 paise = ₹1.

Coins come in ₹1, ₹2, ₹5, ₹10. Notes come in ₹10, ₹20, ₹50, ₹100, ₹200, ₹500. To find a total, add the values of all the coins and notes.

topics.title: Adding Money & Making Change
topics.concept:
We add and subtract money just like normal numbers. To find change, subtract what you spent from what you gave.

Example: you buy a toy for ₹35 and pay with a ₹50 note. Change = 50 − 35 = ₹15.
